items.description:
C&S Consulting Engineers is a Pretoria structural engineering consultancy that designs and analyses structures for residential, commercial and industrial projects. Its services include steel structures, multi-level residential and commercial buildings, mezzanine floors, retaining walls, concrete designs and suspended slab designs, along with raft and strip foundations. The firm also analyses solar plant structures and sign boards.

It prepares the engineering forms that councils and the NHBRC require, including SANS 10400 appointment and occupation certificates and NHBRC enrolment forms. The team works with architects and builders to address potential problems early, and it facilitates townhouse developments from design through to approval. The business is based in Val de Grace, Pretoria, and suits homeowners, developers and builders who need structural designs that meet building regulations.

Campbell Attorneys is a specialist litigation firm that handles personal injury matters, including Road Accident Fund claims, medical malpractice, train accident claims, claims against the police and other injury claims. The firm also takes on contingency litigation, and its site publishes case law, legislation and newsfeed updates for clients who want to follow developments in the field. A results page sets out the outcomes it has achieved.

The firm has offices in Durban and Pretoria and a branch office in Cape Town, and it says it can assist clients anywhere in South Africa. Its website includes an about page, a team page, a fees page and a careers page for prospective clients. The Brooklyn office on Brooks Street in Pretoria suits injured people and their families who need a litigation firm that can take a claim through to court.

CapCircle Management Consultants is a business advisory firm that works at every level of a company, from policy-making and organisational change to project and programme management, system development, workflow and enterprise management. Its services also include project audits, business consulting and support, and recruitment and resourcing. Testimonials on its site describe contract resourcing for telecommunications and financial groups.

The firm runs training courses, including Agile and SAFe training, Agile, Scrum and project management, AI for business and marketing courses for business owners. It is based at Falcon Crest Office Park in Centurion Central, and it suits organisations that need project support, skills training or contract staff without building that capacity in-house.

items.description:
Carports 4 U is a steel carports specialist serving Pretoria and the wider Gauteng area, designing and building carports and patio roofs, pergolas and cantilever shade structures. The company says it has been helping homeowners and developers for more than 20 years to create durable, stylish outdoor spaces. Its services also cover developers and commercial clients who need larger shade and roofing projects.

The business describes itself as family-focused, with honest service, expert workmanship and a process that runs from the first quote to the final installation. Customers can choose from a range of add-ons, and testimonials on the website praise the team as reliable, on time and reasonably priced. The company works from Kameeldrift East, Pretoria, and suits homeowners and developers who want steel shade structures built to last and installed with care.

Catering Companion, trading as Catercom, is an event and corporate catering company serving Johannesburg, Pretoria, Centurion and wider Gauteng. Its menus range from breakfast, buffets and plated meals to cocktails and finger food, and it also offers spit braai, braai and potjie catering, themed and alternative concepts, and super spit services. The company has been catering since 1996.

It also provides Cater Express options and equipment rental, and it says each menu is customised to suit the client's taste and budget. Corporate functions, weddings, birthdays, product launches, team building and theme parties are among the events it caters for. The company is based near Kameeldrift in Pretoria, and it suits hosts who want a dependable caterer for events of many different sizes and styles.

items.description:
CEN Storage is a self-storage park in Annlin, Pretoria, offering secure storage units for household and business goods. The facility provides extended access hours, guards on-site that can respond immediately to problems, armed response and 24-hour CCTV surveillance, which together are designed to keep stored items dry and safe.

Customers also receive packaging material and the free use of a trailer to move belongings into their units, which makes the storage easier to use for people moving house or clearing a home. The site describes these key features and benefits in detail on its pages. The park is in Annlin, Pretoria, and suits households and small businesses that need reliable storage with on-site security and easy access.

items.description:
Centurion Micro Electronics (CME) is a South African supplier of industrial PCs and embedded computing products, selling industrial components, panel PCs and monitors, PC peripherals, computer components and home automation products. The company has served its clients since 1993, and it offers sales, technical support, logistics, importing and distribution, assembly, repairs and marketing.

Its solutions are sourced from qualified local and international suppliers, and it carries stock of popular items so customers can test and evaluate them quickly. The company says its technology reaches defence, rail transport, mining, factory automation, home automation, agricultural, medical, marketing and gaming markets. Its offices are at Lochner Road in Raslouw, Centurion, and the business suits engineers, integrators and technology buyers who need dependable industrial computing hardware.

items.description:
Chempure is a specialty chemical ingredients supplier in The Willows, Pretoria, offering innovative ingredients and formulations for leading brands and products. Its markets include sports, performance and active nutrition, health and wellness, food and beverage, personal care and pharmaceutical preparations. The company describes its ingredients as technical and functional solutions that help clients stay ahead of global trends.

The company presents its story, expertise, ingredients and team on its website, along with a brochure and a news bulletins section for clients who want more detail. It is based at N4 Industrial Gateway Park on Kambathi Street in The Willows, and the business suits product developers and manufacturers who need specialty ingredients for nutrition, personal care and pharmaceutical formulations.

Cheryl Williams Virtual Assistant, trading as CWVA, is a virtual assistant business founded in May 2021 that provides administrative support to businesses and individuals. Its core services cover legal administration, paraplanning and general business support, including estates administration, CIPC applications and submissions, and compliance and FICA requests.

The services also include trademarks administration, dictaphone typing and transcription, legal document formatting and proofreading, invoicing and client liaison, CRM and client file maintenance, and client portfolio management. The site says the business draws on senior PA and legal secretary experience, including work supporting several executives at once. It is based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, and suits professionals who want discreet, detail-focused admin support.

items.description:
CJB Alarms is a Pretoria security business that installs and repairs alarm systems, CCTV and IP camera systems, access control, gate and garage motors, and electric fencing. It supplies and installs what it describes as reliable, well-known brands, and it repairs most makes of alarm and access systems. The business has worked in electronic security since 1994 and says it has more than 30 years of experience.

The company focuses on helping clients choose the best options for their property, whether that is an alarm and panic system, a camera setup or a secure gate. Its website lists its products and a blog, and it presents security as a way for homeowners and businesses to sleep at night knowing they are safe. The business is based in Theresapark, Pretoria, and suits homeowners and small businesses that want systems installed and maintained by one local specialist.

Clickmode is a Pretoria digital marketing agency that helps businesses get more web traffic, win customers and sell more online. Its services include website design, Google Ads, search marketing and SEO, social media marketing, SMS and email campaigns, video marketing, and Google Business Profile setup and optimisation. Facebook and Instagram advertising and landing page design are also part of the offering.

The agency has added AI services, including AI marketing strategy, AI system setup, workflow automation, AI agent development and AI integration for existing businesses. It also offers local SEO and campaign strategy. The business is based in Roodeplaat, Pretoria, and suits companies that want their online marketing, local search presence and automation handled by one team.

items.description:
Comfort Digital is an industrial digital marketing agency serving mining, engineering, construction and industrial businesses across South Africa and the SADC region. Its services include website design and development, technical search engine optimisation, authority-driven content and conversion-focused websites, along with PPC and paid social advertising, social media marketing, digital strategy and conversion rate optimisation.

The agency helps industrial companies strengthen their digital visibility, generate qualified opportunities and position themselves competitively. It offers growth strategy sessions and visibility assessments for prospective clients, and it provides website maintenance and support after launch. The business is based in Akasia, Pretoria, and suits B2B companies in mining and engineering that want steady, qualified enquiries from their online presence.

ConnectedWorks is a South African technology consulting and software development partner, based in Centurion, that helps organisations design, build, integrate and run digital solutions. It focuses on turning complex technology challenges into reliable digital products, platforms and capabilities for ambitious organisations. Its services combine strategy, engineering and delivery in one experienced team.

The firm works in four phases: discover, design, deliver and evolve. It starts each engagement with the real problem and the outcome that matters, builds quality, security and maintainability in from the start, and transfers knowledge to clients as the project runs. The company suits organisations that want a technology partner to guide a project from strategy through to a product that stays useful after launch.

items.description:
Crazy Plastics Express Mayville is a branch of the Crazy Plastics chain in Shop 46, Mayville Mall, Parktown Estate, Pretoria, selling affordable household plastics across storage, kitchen, bathroom, office, cleaning and catering categories. The store's own listing says it serves customers across Pretoria, Akasia, Soshanguve, Roodeplaat and Centurion, and it has an average rating of 4.4 from 64 Google reviews.

The branch does not yet offer delivery from this store, so customers collect their purchases in person. It carries storage and organisation products, kitchenware, cleaning supplies and confectionery supplies, and it has its own store page with a stock check option. The shop suits households, caterers and small offices in the Mayville and Parktown Estate area that want everyday plastic supplies close to home.

Create Infinity is a B-BBEE advisory and consulting firm based in Irene, Centurion, that helps businesses with ownership, management control, skills development, enterprise and supplier development, and socio-economic development strategies. It also offers GRAP training and Youth Employment Service programmes, and it advises both private and public sector clients on financial and systems matters.

The firm presents B-BBEE as a way to build equitable leadership, uplift communities and create lasting business partnerships, and it publishes articles on management control and socio-economic development. Its website says it works with industry experts in various fields, so that what it cannot provide itself is solved through specialist partners. The business suits companies that need practical help with B-BBEE strategy and the training that supports it.

Creators is a construction and property maintenance company based in Celtisdal, Centurion, offering complete property solutions from construction and renovations through to maintenance and finishing. Its services cover residential, commercial and industrial construction, renovations and remodelling, and ongoing maintenance, with end-to-end design and renovation work.

The company's work includes roofing, waterproofing, electrical and plumbing, precision painting, plastering, paving and brickwork, custom steelwork and woodwork, outdoor enhancements such as entertainment areas and swimming pools, and garden and property maintenance. It says its qualified teams and dedicated project supervision keep work to a high standard. The business suits homeowners, property owners and businesses that want one contractor for a whole building or renovation project.

Creciente Consulting is a business intelligence and reporting consultancy in Midstream Ridge, Centurion, offering Power BI reporting services and custom Excel solutions for businesses that want clearer insight from their data. Its work includes tailored Power BI dashboards, financial reports and KPI tracking systems, and it automates reporting so managers spend less time on manual analysis.

Budgets and financial modelling, monitoring of actuals against budget, target setting and scenario-based planning are also part of the service. The consultancy notes that many small and mid-sized businesses cannot justify full-time business intelligence expertise, so it offers its services on a fractional or as-needed basis. It offers a free consultation and a demo dashboard for prospective clients, and it suits small and mid-sized businesses that want reporting and planning without hiring in-house.

Criterion Equipment is the sole distributor of TCM forklifts in Southern Africa. Its range covers internal combustion counterbalance forklifts running on diesel, LPG or petrol, electric counterbalance forklifts, reach trucks, stackers, and manual and electric pallet trucks. The forklifts are sourced primarily from Japan and can be customised for mining, cold storage, beverage handling and flame-proofing applications, with specialised attachments.

The company sells new and used equipment, offers forklift hire and after-sales support, and says it operates a network of six company-owned branches. Mining is one of the sectors it lists on its website. The Hermanstad branch at Industrial Park on Moot Street is one of its sites, and the business suits warehouse and mining operations that need robust materials-handling equipment and reliable maintenance.

The Cross-Border Road Transport Agency (C-BRTA) is a South African government agency that regulates and facilitates cross-border road transport of freight and passengers in the Southern African Development Community region. Its role is to regulate market access and issue cross-border permits, which reduces mobility constraints for road transport operators.

Operators can apply for permits online through its Cross-Easy system, and the agency runs a Cross-Border Incubation Programme that supports emerging and historically disadvantaged operators. It has hosted MSME conferences and says it has driven the region's cross-border business focus for more than 20 years. The agency's Eco-Park office in Centurion suits freight and passenger transport operators who need permits to operate across borders.

CSI Clutch and Brake South Africa is a supplier of new and refurbished truck clutch and brake parts, founded on 18 October 1988 and based on Soutter Street in Pretoria West. Its TRAX range covers clutch kits, pressure plates, clutch bearings and slave cylinders, along with brake linings, brake drums and discs, brake pads, brake shoes and brake hardware for trucks, buses, agricultural equipment, cars, light delivery vehicles and 4x4s.

The company runs a fully equipped factory that refurbishes clutches for trucks, buses, tractors, cars, LDVs and 4x4s, and it supplies brake and clutch workshop equipment such as riveters, bonding ovens, brake lathes, clutch test benches and grinders. Its website includes product catalogues, diagrams and technical tips. It suits fleet workshops, transport operators and mechanics who need parts and clutch refurbishment from one supplier.

Custom Built Canvas Canopies is a Centurion business that makes custom canopies and covers for vehicles. Its canopies have a high-quality aluminium frame that does not rust, are lightweight enough to be fitted by one person, and are secured to the vehicle with saddles, so they can be put on or taken off without much effort. The covers also give shade and protection to pets riding in the load area.

The company says its UV-resistant materials are used wherever possible to last in harsh African weather, and that the canopy's padded construction is built for durability. Its website describes the products as built tough and made to fit. The business is based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, and suits vehicle owners who need a durable, easily fitted canopy for everyday or outdoor use.

items.description:
Deovolent IT Solutions is an IT company in Pretoria North, founded in early 2005, that offers web and custom software development, IT support, VoIP expertise, network infrastructure solutions and managed cloud solutions with backups. It also provides data loss prevention through Zecurion DLP, which protects intellectual property, trade secrets and other sensitive data from insider threats.

The company says it follows a systematic approach and aims to deliver cost-effective IT services, with flexible delivery models that include fixed-price, fixed-time solutions. Its work is built on continuous learning and strategic partnerships with leading software companies. It is based on Gerrit Maritz Road in Pretoria North, and it suits businesses that want one provider for IT support, networks, cloud backups and software development.

DevCom Strategic Communication Consultants, which trades online as The Communication Collective, develops and rolls out business communication and social impact communication for companies with a large African footprint and wide-ranging stakeholders. Its work is tailor-made to each business and covers message testing, brand narrative and tone-of-voice processes, and the integration of information across departments.

Other services include measuring social impact and stakeholder influence, risk management that builds reputation through measured business results, change communication for projects, and managing the communication function to global best practice. It also helps companies through retrenchment and restructuring with measured social outcomes. The consultancy is based in Monument Park, Pretoria, and suits companies that operate across Africa and need communication that works for many different stakeholders.

DFS Deals is an online retailer that sells daily deals on beauty and lifestyle products, household items and wellness supplements, including beauty and lifestyle products, household items and wellness supplements. Its catalogue includes Avon perfume and cosmetics, Dr Rashel skincare, Miira wellness supplements and household goods such as a portable dual gas stove. The business delivers across South Africa from its base on Moot Street in Daspoort, Pretoria.

Its website publishes shipping, refund and terms of service policies, and it says customers can call or email the friendly staff for help. Shoppers can read the policies on the site before ordering. The shop suits customers who want beauty, skincare and household products bought online and delivered to their door, and who prefer one retailer for everyday purchases.

items.description:
Digital Interactive is a Pretoria graphic design and digital agency, trusted by South African enterprises and SMEs since 2000. Its services include layout design for annual reports and publications, brand assets and corporate-grade creative design, along with high-conversion websites and custom software. It also offers digital marketing and lead generation, with online campaigns built for South African audiences.

Its e-commerce and web platforms are integrated with local South African payment gateways, and its motion graphics and video work aims to simplify complex ideas and showcase products. The studio offers retainer arrangements and a where-to-start guide for new clients. Testimonials on its site come from organisations that have commissioned strategic plan design and animation work. The business is based at Persequor Technopark in Lynnwood, Pretoria, and suits organisations that need polished reports, websites and video under one roof.

items.description:
Dis-Chem Irene Village is a new Dis-Chem health hub in Shop E201 at Irene Village Mall, Centurion, combining a pharmacy with clinic services, insurance products, wellness and beauty. The pharmacy handles self-medication, prescriptions and advice, while the clinic offers consultations, vaccinations and care for the whole family. Hub advisors meet visitors on arrival and guide them to the right service.

Customers can explore life insurance, medical insurance and gap cover, grab vitamins, supplements and everyday essentials in the wellness section, and try skincare and make-up at an in-store beauty activation pod. The company describes the hub as a whole new way to look after health. It suits families and shoppers in Irene and Centurion who want pharmacy, clinic and health cover services in one place.

items.description:
DP Du Plessis Inc is a family-run law firm in Centurion that has operated since 1979 and describes itself as a leading Centurion law practice with a reputation built over four decades. Its family law services cover divorce, maintenance, custody agreements and antenuptial contracts, and its property law work covers property transactions, commercial leases and real estate litigation. Conveyancing, bond registrations and notarial services are also offered.

The firm handles general and civil litigation, estate services and trusts, and its website includes a bond registration calculator. Its about page describes a philosophy of putting client needs first and combining legal expertise with personal care. The office is in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, and the firm suits families, property buyers and sellers, and businesses in Gauteng that need careful legal support from one practice.

Drain Brain is a plumbing company in Parktown Estate, Pretoria, that offers plumbing maintenance, installations and renovations. Its services cover unblocking blocked drains, sewers, sinks and toilets, fixing dripping taps and leaking pipes, repairing or replacing burst geysers, and bathtub, basin and toilet repairs and replacements. Plumbing construction, including refurbishing and remodelling bathrooms and new installations, is also part of the work.

The company says it focuses on speedy turnaround times, cost-effective pricing and excellent customer service, and it offers an estimate on request. Its website says it operates across South Africa. The business suits homeowners, landlords and businesses that need a plumber for an urgent blockage or a bathroom renovation and want an estimate before work starts.

Dunwoodie Travel Lodge is a four-star rated guest lodge in Waverley, Pretoria, rated by the Tourism Grading Council of South Africa. Its rooms are all en-suite with air-conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a stocked coffee and tea station and comfortable beds, and the lodge offers secure, free parking. It describes its accommodation as luxury that is still affordable, with single, double, family and group sharing rooms available.

The lodge is open every day of the year, offers meals at an extra charge and has conference facilities for meetings and events. The website says many of its clients are returnees, and it points visitors to its Google reviews as part of its track record. The lodge suits business travellers, families and small groups who want a comfortable base in the Pretoria area with secure parking and a reliable place to stay.

Duster Dollies is a residential and commercial cleaning company based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, serving homes and offices in Pretoria and Centurion. Its services include team cleaning on a weekly, bi-weekly or twice-weekly basis, rent-a-dolly placements, pre- and post-occupation cleaning, once-off deep and spring cleaning, post-construction cleaning, and carpet and upholstery cleaning.

The company's commercial service covers office cleaning, and its website says the team takes on the jobs that customers would rather not do. Recurring and once-off options let households and businesses choose how often the cleaning happens. The business suits busy homeowners, landlords and office managers who want reliable cleaning in Pretoria and Centurion without arranging it themselves.
